name: place-deflect
note: LEDGER #51, THE DEFLECTION ARM of place-noop -- fly it in the same session, second. Byte-identical entry condition, replicate count and pinned throttle to place-noop; the ONLY difference is that two real azimuth steps are commanded between placements, so a difference between the two cards is attributable to DEFLECTION at matched placement count and matched (minimal) flight time. That is a cleaner contrast than pairing against oblique-6-dwell-t040, which would confound deflection with 126 s of flight per replicate -- and t040 cannot be used directly anyway, since it declares repeat 4 over a 16-lane fleet and both are read off the card, not off F1. +-25 deg was chosen to exercise the ROLL channel: the one surviving correlate for why this is Darkreach-and-EW1-specific is maxRollAngularVel 3 alongside maxPitchAngularVel 0.3. Same readout as place-noop: the replicate index the run aborts at, off the '# stop' line -- NOT dmgFrac, which is 0.0 on every aborted capture by construction.
